items.name: Dumbbells
items.visual_hint: pairs of short hand-held bars with a weight at each end

items.name: Adjustable bench
items.visual_hint: padded bench whose back rest tilts to different angles

items.name: Flat bench
items.visual_hint: padded bench with a fixed flat seat

items.name: Barbell
items.visual_hint: long straight bar, about 2 m, loaded with round plates at both ends

items.name: EZ curl bar
items.visual_hint: short bar with zig-zag bends in the middle for the hands

items.name: Squat / power rack
items.visual_hint: tall steel frame with uprights and hooks or safety bars that hold a barbell

items.name: Smith machine
items.visual_hint: barbell fixed between two vertical rails so it only slides up and down

items.name: Cable machine
items.visual_hint: tall frame with adjustable pulleys, cables, handles and a weight stack

items.name: Lat pulldown machine
items.visual_hint: seat with knee pads under a high pulley and a wide overhead bar

items.name: Seated row machine
items.visual_hint: low seat and foot plate facing handles that are pulled toward the torso

items.name: Chest press machine
items.visual_hint: upright seat with handles at chest height that are pushed forward

items.name: Shoulder press machine
items.visual_hint: upright seat with handles at shoulder height that are pushed overhead

items.name: Pec deck
items.visual_hint: upright seat with two padded arms or handles that swing together in front of the chest

items.name: Leg press machine
items.visual_hint: reclined seat facing a large foot platform that is pushed away with the legs

items.name: Leg curl machine
items.visual_hint: bench or seat with a padded roller behind the lower legs

items.name: Leg extension machine
items.visual_hint: seat with a padded roller in front of the shins

items.name: Pull-up bar
items.visual_hint: horizontal bar fixed high on a wall, door frame or rack

items.name: Dip station
items.visual_hint: two parallel waist-high handles that hold the body up on straight arms

items.name: Kettlebells
items.visual_hint: round cast-iron weights with a single handle on top

items.name: Resistance bands
items.visual_hint: elastic bands or tubes, often coloured, sometimes with handles

items.name: Medicine ball
items.visual_hint: heavy rubber or leather ball about the size of a football

items.name: Stability ball
items.visual_hint: large inflatable ball, roughly 55 to 75 cm across

items.name: Foam roller
items.visual_hint: cylinder of dense foam, roughly 30 to 90 cm long

items.name: Exercise mat
items.visual_hint: thin padded mat rolled out on the floor

items.name: Jump rope
items.visual_hint: rope with a handle at each end

items.name: Treadmill
items.visual_hint: machine with a moving belt and a front console for walking or running

items.name: Stationary bike
items.visual_hint: bike frame with pedals and a seat that stays in place

items.name: Rowing machine
items.visual_hint: long low rail with a sliding seat, foot straps and a pull handle

items.name: Elliptical
items.visual_hint: machine with two long foot pedals moving in an oval and moving arm handles

items.name: Stair climber
items.visual_hint: machine with rotating steps or two pedals that move up and down
